title: The 1975 jazz concert tour of Denmark and Scandinavia
summary: Caldwell toured Denmark, Sweden and Norway in September 1975 and missed Benny Waters and Buddy Tate, who were elsewhere.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan
